psychological_meaning: Desert evokes feelings of warmth, dryness, and a connection to nature. It suggests resilience, endurance, and a sense of timelessness. The color can also represent simplicity, minimalism, and a grounding earthiness. Its muted tone often brings a sense of calm and stability, reminiscent of arid landscapes and natural textures.
